mapper.select: select sysMenu.*, sysLanguage.field_value as name, parentLanguage.field_value as parentName from sys_menu sysMenu left join sys_language sysLanguage on sysLanguage.table_id = sysMenu.id and sysLanguage.table_name='sys_menu' and sysLanguage.field_name='name' and sysLanguage.language=#{language} and sysLanguage.logical_delete = 0 left join sys_language parentLanguage on sysLanguage.table_id = sysMenu.pid and parentLanguage.table_name='sys_menu' and parentLanguage.field_name='name' and parentLanguage.language=#{language} and parentLanguage.logical_delete = 0 where sysMenu.logical_delete = 0 and sysMenu.id = #{id}

select sysMenu.*, sysLanguage.field_value as name from sys_menu sysMenu left join sys_language sysLanguage on sysLanguage.table_id = sysMenu.id and sysLanguage.table_name='sys_menu' and sysLanguage.field_name='name' and sysLanguage.language=#{language} and sysLanguage.logical_delete = 0 where sysMenu.logical_delete = 0
and sysMenu.menu_type in
#{type}
order by sysMenu.sort asc

select sysMenu.* from sys_role_user sysRoleUser inner join sys_role_menu sysRoleMenu on sysRoleUser.role_id = sysRoleMenu.role_id and sysRoleMenu.logical_delete = 0 inner join sys_menu sysMenu on sysRoleMenu.menu_id = sysMenu.id and sysMenu.logical_delete = 0 where sysRoleUser.logical_delete = 0 and sysRoleUser.user_id = #{userId} order by sysMenu.sort asc
